GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5l Settled Down Mid Field 8th fence 8 Lengths 1000m 9th 7 Lengths 600m 9th 8 Lengths home turn 3rd last rails run Straight no run on final 200m # never in it/weak

Jumped fairly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield 3 Wide (7L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & improving slowly Four Wide from 550m. Pushed out 8W (5L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground 9W in straight. # Wide/never likely.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin.  Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Wide early then Went Forward to settle outside and behind the leader at 1000m, made no ground to 2.5 Lengths 2-3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # mostly Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When racing wide in the early stages was permitted to work forward to settle outside the leader passing the 1000m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well took sit 2nd fence 2 Lengths 1000m 3rd 3 Lengths home turn 2nd 2 Lengths took lead 100m Straight Kept Going Too Well # too strong late
Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, railed to 3.5 Lengths turning, Held Up 600m-400m, hugged fence improving only very marginally in Straight # never a real threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped shortly after the start. Unable to improve between the 600m and 400m when held up on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , little change to turn, Held Up home turn then steered centre of track Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in the ok going in Straight # slow out/fair late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Unable to improve approaching and rounding the home turn when held up on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down last of six runners 6.5 Lengths on fence, little change to 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, Hooked Out widest Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # never a real threat
ms 1len well back to 2nd last fence 8len up 500m made ground last 200 # ok for further

Debut for stable. Slow away. No early speed & raced @ rear on inside (8L from lead). Stayed @ rear on inside midrace & pushed to chase from 500m. Chasing Two Wide (8L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 200m & ran on soundly in last 200m. # Good from rear.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Apprentice reported that her mount began only fairly & got well out of its ground in the e&m stages despite her constant urgings. App stated her mount surprised at how well it let down in the straight and it finished the event strongly.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing the start, Settled Down last of five runners trailing 4 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 2 Lengths Two Wide turning, Dropped Out in Straight # weakened badly
Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 1 length Two Wide turning, joined Lead Straightening Up , Headed 250m, weakened to the line # weakened last 250m
